name: The Epic (Sort of Not Really) of Koneko: A Game Made in 4 Hours
storyline: Koneko has always had this mysterious door in the back of his house, but he doesn't know what's behind it... What's more, it's locked tight and can only be unlocked by two magical gemstones. Now he must adventure out into the world to find them and discover what's behind the mysterious door.
summary: The Epic (Sort of Not Really) of Koneko is a very short top-down adventure game made in 4 hours, following a little cat called Koneko as he tries to unlock a mysterious door at the back of his house.
